Australia PR Document Checklist

Having the right documents ready is crucial for a smooth PR application. This checklist covers the main documents you will need.

Start with your points calculation: PR Points Calculator.

Identity Documents

  • Passport (all pages with stamps and visas)
  • Birth certificate
  • National identity card (if applicable)
  • Name change certificates (if applicable)

Qualification Documents

  • Degree certificates
  • Academic transcripts
  • Professional registration certificates
  • Course completion certificates

Employment Documents

  • Employment reference letters
  • Payslips
  • Employment contracts
  • Tax returns
  • Superannuation statements (if Australian work)

English Test Results

  • IELTS Test Report Form
  • PTE Academic Score Report
  • TOEFL iBT (if accepted)

Character Documents

  • Police clearance certificates from all countries lived in 12+ months
  • Australian Federal Police check (if applicable)

Health Documents

  • Medical examination results (conducted by panel physician)

Document Preparation Tips

  • Start collecting documents early
  • Keep certified copies of everything
  • Organise documents by category
  • Ensure translations are certified
  • Check validity periods

Frequently Asked Questions

What documents do I need for skills assessment?
You typically need identity documents, qualifications (degrees, transcripts), employment evidence (reference letters, payslips), and English test results. Specific requirements vary by assessing authority.
Do I need original documents?
Certified copies are usually accepted. Some authorities may request originals for verification. Always check the specific requirements of your assessing authority and the Department of Home Affairs.
How old can my documents be?
Police clearances are typically valid for 12 months. English tests are valid for 3 years. Skills assessments usually valid for 2-3 years. Employment evidence should be current at time of application.
Can documents be in another language?
Documents not in English must be translated by a certified translator. Both the original and translation must be provided.
